description.value: Starbucks is a globally recognized coffeehouse chain serving espresso drinks, teas, Frappuccinos, and a range of food items. This Vancouver location offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a convenient rest stop on a cycling route. Touring cyclists will find a familiar, accessible venue for a hot or cold drink and a snack.
